visual.description: Full-viewport hero with left column containing large heading and two CTA buttons, right column containing body text paragraph, over a dark background with blue radial glow.
Full-width section at bottom of hero viewport showing oversized brand logo icon and FORMLESS wordmark centered horizontally at massive scale.
Left half contains a large 3D glass geometric object image, right half contains a large numeral '01', service title, and two body text paragraphs, separated by a thin vertical rule.
Same sticky two-column structure as the previous service panel, with the 3D object rotated slightly, numeral '02', and share.stream service description on the right.
Third panel in the sticky scroll sequence, same two-column structure with numeral '03' and Consulting Services description on the right.

Full-width section with massive display headline text spanning the top, below which three overlapping cards (code snippet card, portrait image card, office image card) are arranged in an irregular three-column grid with vertical offset and overlap.
Left column contains a small hexagon icon and large three-line heading; right side is empty, creating heavy left-weighted asymmetry over a pure black background.
Left column contains a portrait photograph in a narrow vertical rectangle, right column contains a large pull-quote in medium-weight type, both anchored to the bottom of the section.

Full-width section with centered oversized CTA headline, a text link with arrow icon below, then social icons in a horizontal row at bottom-left, all over a dark background with teal-blue radial glow.
Footer closes with the large FORMLESS logo lockup (icon + wordmark) centered, with a three-item legal link row (copyright, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service) at the very bottom.
